text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Rate of legal and illegal gambling leads to concern. Gamblers Anonymous see a huge gambling problem in Malta and express disappointment that the government is doing too little about it.
- Trade between Malta and Australia up. Trade was valued at $2.3 million in 1987 and at $6.5 million last year.
- Opposition leader insists on more capital investment in Gozo. Alfred Sant says capital investment on the sister island is not comparable to the island's population.
